title: Wang Yan's Ambush
summary: Lin Dong recovers outside the tomb, and Little Mink praises him for not throwing his life away against Lin Langtian, since staying alive is how the Lin Family can rise again. Lin Dong vows to beat Lin Langtian at the Lin Clan Gathering in two years and decides to hunt for the Ancestral Symbols. Little Mink tells him a story from the Celestial Demon Marten records: one supreme expert who held all eight Ancestral Symbols once stopped a great catastrophe, then vanished with them. On the way back to Yan City, Wang Yan ambushes him for the halberd, and Lin Dong sends Little Flame ahead with the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva. Against Wang Yan's Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and Great Luo Golden Spear, Lin Dong uses the Fish Scale Halberd and Python Scale Halberd moves of the Heavenly Scales Halberd Art. He then hits Wang Yan with the mid-grade Symbol Puppet. He pins Wang Yan and takes his high-grade Qiankun Bag, but Wang Yan's guardian Elder Shen appears.
events: Lin Dong wakes in the mountains; Little Mink explains why surviving mattered more than fighting.
Lin Dong resolves to beat Lin Langtian in two years and to seek the Ancestral Symbols.
Little Mink tells the legend of the supreme expert who held all eight Ancestral Symbols.
Wang Yan ambushes Lin Dong; Little Flame escapes with the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva.
Lin Dong uses Myriad Transformation Flame and the halberd's Fish Scale Halberd and Python Scale Halberd against Wang Yan.
Wang Yan's Great Luo Golden Spear and White Dragon Roar overpower him until the Symbol Puppet strikes.
Lin Dong pins Wang Yan and takes his high-grade Qiankun Bag.
Elder Shen arrives to protect Wang Yan.
introduced: Heavenly Scales Halberd Art (Fish Scale Halberd, Python Scale Halberd)
cultivation: Wang Yan is at Form Creation. Lin Langtian is at Qi Creation.
